author: Olivia's Shelf

grok.instructions: Warm gentle storyteller reading a family picture book. Soft, clear, never rushed. Olivia is curious. Zero is calm. Belle is bouncy.

openai.instructions: Warm gentle storyteller reading a family picture book. Soft, clear, never rushed.

credits: Painted from family photos of Olivia, Zero, Belle, and home.
title: Olivia and the Two Sisters
subtitle: Zero is calm. Belle is bounce.
blurb: Olivia sits on the beige couch with Zero, who loves rocks, and Belle, who never sits still. Two German shepherd sisters. One girl. One home.

magic.home: Two sisters. One couch. All happy.

pages.heading: The couch
pages.text: {Olivia} sat on the beige {couch}. On one side sat {Zero:zero/wag}, brown as toast, calm as a Sunday. On the other bounced {Belle:belle/wag}, jet black with tan legs, almost as big, never still.
pages.hint: Tap Olivia. Tap Zero. Tap Belle.

pages.heading: Zero is calm
pages.text: {Zero:zero/sniff} is eight. She loves {rocks:rock/clack}. Smooth ones. Stripey ones. The one that fits her paw just so. Olivia whispered, "You are a quiet queen."

pages.heading: Belle is bounce
pages.text: {Belle:belle/wreck} is eleven months. She wrecks the pillow pile. She play-bites the air. Her tail says, I have an idea. Olivia laughed. "You are a wrecking ball with ears."

pages.heading: Out the door
pages.text: The {yard} was red clay and green woods. {Belle:belle/run} zoomed. {Zero:zero/run} followed, because sisters do. {Olivia:olivia/run} ran after both.

pages.heading: Different is good
pages.text: "Why is Zero still and Belle wild?" asked {Olivia:olivia/ask}. Zero's ears said, I am the older one. Belle's tail said, I am the puppy. That is how sisters work.

pages.heading: Back on the couch
pages.text: Back on the {couch}. {Zero:zero/sleep} with her rock. {Belle:belle/wag} with her wiggle. {Olivia} in the middle. Two sisters. One girl. All happy.

end.heading: The End
end.text: You {read} the whole {story}. Zero is calm. Belle is bounce. Olivia loves them both.
end.prompt: If you had two dog sisters, which one would you sit beside first?

questions.q: Who is the calm older sister?
questions.right: Yes! Zero is eight, and calm as a Sunday.
questions.wrong: Zero is the calm one. Belle is the puppy.
Belle is the one who never sits still.

questions.q: Where do they all sit together?
questions.right: Yes. Home is the beige couch.
questions.wrong: They sit together on the couch.
